text:
## Security Training  
**Mandatory Annual Training:**
- All staff: 1-hour security awareness training
- Phishing simulation (monthly test emails)
- Certification: Staff complete quiz
- Management: 2-hour security responsibility training  
**Topics:**
- Phishing and social engineering
- Password security
- Data protection
- Incident reporting
- Physical security
- Regulatory compliance  
**Non-Compliance:**
- Failure to complete training: Disciplinary action
- Repeated policy violations: Termination

raw_entities.description: The risk of unauthorized access due to weak, reused, or compromised passwords. This is mitigated through mandatory security awareness training covering password security best practices.

raw_entities.description: The risk that security incidents go unreported or undetected due to staff lack of awareness or knowledge of reporting procedures. This is mitigated through incident reporting training.

raw_entities.name: Physical Security Breach
raw_entities.description: The risk of unauthorized physical access to facilities, equipment, or documents. This is addressed through physical security training.
